title: Mischaracterize
summary: MISCHAR'ACTERIZE, verb transitive [See Character.] To characterize falsely or erroneously; to give a wrong character to. They totally mischaracterize the action.

inlines.v: MISCHAR'ACTERIZE, verb transitive [See Character.] To characterize falsely or erroneously; to give a wrong character to. They totally mischaracterize the action.
